description: 文本提问，文本+语音回答，回答约 180 个英文词（实验 11 的最长负载），max_tokens 256，温度 0，seed 为 null。语音预计约 60–75 秒，低于 talker 每个请求 2048 个语音编码（约 82 秒）的默认上限；实际长度在正确性检查里核对。

texts: In about 180 words, explain how a database index makes lookups faster, with a simple example.
In about 180 words, describe how a city water system brings clean water to homes.
Explain in about 180 words how a compiler turns source code into a running program.
In about 180 words, describe the life cycle of a star like the Sun.
In about 180 words, explain how a bank decides whether to approve a small loan.
In about 180 words, explain how noise-cancelling headphones work.
